**Repaired finding submitted: deviation (§ 12.4)**

Fixes applied to address the two failed checks:

1. **Duration check** — the duration is now written as a plain numeral, "**12 months** after that involvement ends", removing the "twelve (12)" spelled-out form the checker missed.
2. **Minimal edit** — replaced the full-sentence rewrite with **three surgical substitutions** inside the existing sentence, preserving the original scaffolding ("12.4 … during the term or for … ."). I also dropped the optional "employment already ended" limb the verifier flagged as wordy.

Resulting clause: *"12.4 Neither party shall solicit any employee of the other party directly involved in the Services during the term or for 12 months after that involvement ends, except in response to general recruitment not targeted at that party's personnel or an unsolicited approach."*

That delivers every fallback element — mutual, solicitation-only (no-hire struck), Services personnel only, 12 months from end of involvement, general-recruitment and unsolicited-approach carve-outs — while the comment keeps deletion (the preferred position, supported by § 12.3) as the opening ask.
